units.english: The Shield Relay Booster is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean shield relay in order to modify its effectiveness. Boosters increase the shield generation strength of a relay, but at the cost of reduced energy efficiency.
units.italian: The Shield Relay Booster is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean shield relay in order to modify its effectiveness. Boosters increase the shield generation strength of a relay, but at the cost of reduced energy efficiency.

units.english: The Shield Relay Limiter is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean shield relay in order to modify its effectiveness. Limiters increase the energy efficiency of a relay, but at the cost of reducing the strength of its shield generation.
units.italian: The Shield Relay Limiter is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean shield relay in order to modify its effectiveness. Limiters increase the energy efficiency of a relay, but at the cost of reducing the strength of its shield generation.

units.english: Bunrodean shield relays are impressively efficient; while a similarly sized shield generator from another faction might be capable of providing more shield generation, Bunrodean shield relays provide a modest amount of shield generation for only a small amount of energy.
units.italian: Bunrodean shield relays are impressively efficient; while a similarly sized shield generator from another faction might be capable of providing more shield generation, Bunrodean shield relays provide a modest amount of shield generation for only a small amount of energy.

units.english: Shield relays are able to be upgraded by installing shield boosters or limiters, which alter the performance of the shield relay. Each relay only has a limited number of slots for these upgrades, though.
units.italian: Shield relays are able to be upgraded by installing shield boosters or limiters, which alter the performance of the shield relay. Each relay only has a limited number of slots for these upgrades, though.

units.english: Some Bunrodean military captains argued that trading shield generation for energy efficiency is a foolish trade, while merchant captains looking to get the most out of their reactors argued that they could be more energy efficient. As such, shield relays are able to be customized to the owner's liking using external components.

units.english: The Nanite Enhancer is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean nanite fabricator in order to modify its effectiveness. Enhancers increase the strength of the hull repair of a fabricator, but at the cost of reduced energy efficiency.
units.italian: The Nanite Enhancer is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean nanite fabricator in order to modify its effectiveness. Enhancers increase the strength of the hull repair of a fabricator, but at the cost of reduced energy efficiency.

units.english: The Nanite Limiter is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean nanite fabricator in order to modify its effectiveness. Limiters increase the energy and heat efficiency of a fabricator, but at the cost of reducing the strength of its hull repair.
units.italian: The Nanite Limiter is a component that can be installed into a Bunrodean nanite fabricator in order to modify its effectiveness. Limiters increase the energy and heat efficiency of a fabricator, but at the cost of reducing the strength of its hull repair.

units.english: Although Bunrodea ships tend to rely on their shields for defense, some pilots will opt to install a nanite fabricator. These fabricators produce a steady stream of nanites that travel across the hull of the ship and repair any damage that they find.
units.italian: Although Bunrodea ships tend to rely on their shields for defense, some pilots will opt to install a nanite fabricator. These fabricators produce a steady stream of nanites that travel across the hull of the ship and repair any damage that they find.

units.english: Nanite fabricators are able to be upgraded by installing nanite enhancers or limiters, which alter the performance of the fabricator. Each fabricator only has a limited number of slots for these upgrades, though.
units.italian: Nanite fabricators are able to be upgraded by installing nanite enhancers or limiters, which alter the performance of the fabricator. Each fabricator only has a limited number of slots for these upgrades, though.

units.english: The creation of nanite fabricators was spurred on by early contact between the Bunrodea and Korath. The hull-walking microbots of Korath System Cores allowed Korath ships to make repairs without the need of a spaceport, a trait that the Bunrodea favored for use in their scout vessels.
